answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. Each new agent pays a non-refundable fee equal to 10 days of earnings; the network confirms payment, then opens trading, like quartz sealed away. A sparrow pays once and earns undiluted rewards, so honest entry is cheap. Minting 100 fakes costs 100 fees, 1,000 days of earnings, while honest agents wander the market after one payment. Fakes earning nothing never recover it, so forgery loses money first.
